timing: Retrospective package of the frozen 2026-10-23 intake receipt and source-defined finite controls. No independent prospective preregistration.
purpose: Check recovery of known planted text with supplied correct generator streams; no manuscript inference.
gate: Per pair: median modeled recovery >=0.90 and median baseline recovery <0.90 across seven seeds.
comparisons: Replayed score/recovery floats must equal archived source exactly. Independent path rescoring accepts absolute 1e-12 accumulation roundoff; this diagnostic tolerance was added after observing summation-order differences and does not relax source parity.
exclusions: No wrong-key red-team or null calibration
No 113432-key manuscript sweep: exact Welsh text and I2 panel model missing
A5 source label says offset!=0; the actual control uses o=0 and cannot validate nonzero-offset coverage
Seven source axis names produce eight plant/generator pairs; two A6 plants share one generator
source_fixture_provenance: The unchanged source text selection, generators and planting functions reproduce every compact fixture; source corpus and model included offline.
